title: PTM-01 Buyer signup/login/password reset
body:
## Story
As an enthusiast, I want to create an account and log in so I can purchase and manage maps.

## Acceptance Criteria
- User can sign up with email and password.
- Email verification required before purchase.
- User can log in, log out, and reset password.
- Session persists across refresh.
- Failed login messages do not reveal account existence.

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 5

title: PTM-02 Tuner role request and verification workflow
body:
## Story
As a tuner, I want a seller account so I can publish maps.

## Acceptance Criteria
- User can request tuner role from profile settings.
- Tuner profile requires display name, location, and contact email.
- New tuner accounts are marked unverified by default.
- Only tuner role users can create listings.
- Admin can approve or reject tuner verification.

## Dependencies
- PTM-01

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 3

title: PTM-03 Vehicle setup CRUD
body:
## Story
As a buyer, I want to save my exact vehicle setup so compatibility checks are reliable.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Setup includes make, model, year, engine, ECU ID, transmission, fuel type, installed mods.
- Required fields are validated before save.
- Buyer can save multiple setups.
- Buyer can edit and delete setups.
- Setup is available to compatibility logic.

## Dependencies
- PTM-01

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 8

title: PTM-04 Compatibility evaluator and result badges
body:
## Story
As a buyer, I want clear compatibility outcomes so I avoid unsafe purchases.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Results show Compatible, Partially Compatible, Not Compatible.
- Incompatible listings cannot be purchased.
- Partial compatibility displays missing requirements.
- Decision is deterministic from saved rules.
- Compatibility output is exposed to listing/search pages.

## Dependencies
- PTM-03

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 8

title: PTM-05 Marketplace search and filters
body:
## Story
As a buyer, I want to find maps quickly using filters tied to my setup.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Search supports make/model/engine/fuel/stage filters.
- Results show compatibility badges for selected setup.
- Sorting by relevance and newest is available.
- Listing cards include tuner, stage, price, and verification status.
- Search response p95 under 1.5 seconds at MVP load.

## Dependencies
- PTM-04

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 5

title: PTM-06 Public tuner profile and trust metrics shell
body:
## Story
As a buyer, I want to evaluate tuner credibility before purchasing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Public profile includes bio, verification status, supported platforms.
- Profile lists published maps.
- Trust metric placeholders for installs, average rating, support response median.
- Unverified status is clearly marked.
- Profile is shareable via stable URL.

## Dependencies
- PTM-02

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 5

title: PTM-07 Map listing create/edit/publish with validation
body:
## Story
As a tuner, I want to publish map listings with complete requirements and expected outcomes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Required fields: title, supported vehicle params, stage, fuel, required mods, price.
- Optional fields: dyno images, evidence notes, known limitations.
- Save as draft or publish.
- Published listings appear in search within 1 minute.
- Invalid compatibility metadata blocks publish.

## Dependencies
- PTM-02
- PTM-04

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 8

title: PTM-08 Map version upload and changelog history
body:
## Story
As a tuner, I want versioned map uploads so customers receive traceable revisions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Tuner can upload new version with semantic label.
- Each version requires changelog notes.
- Version history is visible on listing page.
- Order entitlements remain bound to purchased version unless explicitly upgraded.
- Download page shows exact version and timestamp.

## Dependencies
- PTM-07

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 8

title: PTM-09 Listing moderation controls for admins
body:
## Story
As an admin, I want moderation tools so policy-violating listings can be controlled quickly.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Admin can unpublish listing with reason.
- Admin can re-publish listing after remediation.
- Moderation actions are audit logged with actor and timestamp.
- Affected tuner receives notification.
- Unpublished listings are removed from marketplace views.

## Dependencies
- PTM-07

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 3

title: PTM-10 Checkout with compatibility gate and terms acceptance
body:
## Story
As a buyer, I want secure checkout with compatibility enforcement so unsafe purchases are prevented.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Checkout re-validates compatibility before payment attempt.
- Buyer must accept license and VIN policy checkbox.
- Payment attempt cannot proceed if required terms are unchecked.
- Order summary includes map version and setup context.
- Purchase button disabled for incompatible configurations.

## Dependencies
- PTM-05
- PTM-08

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 8

title: PTM-11 Payment events and order entitlement
body:
## Story
As a platform, I need robust payment and entitlement events so downloads are unlocked only after valid payment.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Successful payment creates order and entitlement records.
- Failed payment creates no entitlement record.
- Payment events are idempotent.
- Confirmation email sent on successful purchase.
- All payment transitions are audit logged.

## Dependencies
- PTM-10

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 5

title: PTM-12 Signed download links, checksum, and download audit log
body:
## Story
As a buyer, I want secure downloadable files with integrity checks so I can install confidently.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Download links are signed and time-limited.
- Download page displays checksum/hash.
- Buyer can re-download from valid entitlement.
- Each download event is logged with order/user/version context.
- Unauthorized access attempts are denied and logged.

## Dependencies
- PTM-11

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 5

title: PTM-13 Order history and download center
body:
## Story
As a buyer, I want order history and access to purchased files in one place.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Buyer can view past orders with status and timestamps.
- Each order links to map version and setup snapshot.
- Download action available when entitlement exists.
- Non-entitled orders show clear error state.
- Order list paginates for larger history.

## Dependencies
- PTM-11
- PTM-12

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 3

title: PTM-14 Support ticket creation tied to order/setup/version
body:
## Story
As a buyer, I want support tickets linked to my purchase and setup so troubleshooting is contextual.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Ticket form auto-attaches order ID, map version, and selected setup.
- Buyer can choose issue type: install, drivability, performance, refund.
- Tuner receives notification on ticket create.
- Ticket has status lifecycle (Open, Waiting on Buyer, Resolved, Closed).
- Non-purchasers cannot open map-specific tickets.

## Dependencies
- PTM-11
- PTM-13

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 8

title: PTM-15 Ticket thread, status lifecycle, and notifications
body:
## Story
As a buyer and tuner, I want threaded ticket communication so revisions and status are clear.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Buyer and tuner can exchange threaded messages.
- Status updates are visible on ticket timeline.
- Email notifications fire for new messages and status changes.
- Ticket timeline includes who changed what and when.
- Closed tickets are read-only unless reopened by authorized role.

## Dependencies
- PTM-14

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 5

title: PTM-16 Admin dashboard for tuners/listings/orders/tickets/reviews
body:
## Story
As an admin, I want cross-system operational visibility and controls to keep trust high.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Dashboard includes users/tuners/listings/orders/tickets/reviews views.
- Admin can verify/unverify tuner accounts.
- Admin can suspend accounts and unpublish listings.
- Admin can flag/refine refund workflow status.
- All admin actions are audit logged.

## Dependencies
- PTM-09
- PTM-15

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 8

title: PTM-17 Verified-buyer ratings and reviews
body:
## Story
As a buyer, I want to rate purchased maps so others can evaluate real outcomes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Only verified purchasers can review that map listing.
- Rating range is 1 to 5 with optional text.
- One active review per order; edits allowed.
- Reviews roll up into listing/tuner aggregate rating.
- Admin can hide policy-violating reviews with reason log.

## Dependencies
- PTM-13

## Notes
- Priority: P1
- Story points: 5

title: PTM-18 MVP observability and launch dashboard metrics
body:
## Story
As a product team, we need core telemetry so we can validate MVP health and conversion.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Track conversion from compatible listing view to purchase.
- Track refund/dispute rate and ticket volume.
- Track median first support response time.
- Track download failures and payment failures.
- Dashboard is visible to admin users with daily trend view.

## Dependencies
- PTM-10
- PTM-12
- PTM-15

## Notes
- Priority: P0
- Story points: 3
